0.0: Aha! Hello, my explorer friend! It's been a long time since I last saw you. I really missed you! Why, you ask? Well... I got the answers to your questions! You know, the one about that alchemist with the dark personality!
0.1: I dug up some very juicy clues on him. You seemed so interested, I didn't want to let you down! But now is the time to meet him, at last.

no.0: What? No? If you don't want to, I won't force you... But you must know that I really worked hard to get this information. Like, I really went far and put in a LOT of effort... *Sniff sniff*

1.0: Um... can I help you? I don't think we have ever met. You cannot just walk into a lab like that, but... I am in such a great mood today, that nothing really bothers me today. Haha...

npc.0: Huh? You didn't meet with De Lang yet? What are you doing just standing around here then?

QuestInfo.0: I entered #m261020401# without really thinking too much about it... As usual, #b#p2111006##k the talkative ghost starts up a conversation. I don't really want to listen to him go on and on about his life. What should I do?
QuestInfo.1: When I asked about #p2111002#'s past that I saw through him in the past, Parwen's face lit up and showed me #p2111002# again. Hmmm... He looks like a bit of time has passed since I last saw him...
QuestInfo.2: I tried to start up a conversation with an obviously tired #p2111002#. His face may have the look of exhaustion, but he managed to smile just a bit. He may have failed the experiment, but he said he has succeeded in creating a new medicine for #p2111005#...
